npcs.name: 售票员
npcs.role: the clerk at the railway ticket window
npcs.character: Quick, precise, reads names off passports at speed.
knows: Trains to the Wall leave every hour
The ticket costs 20 yuan and needs your passport

explains.护照: 去别的国家用的小本子。

npcs.name: 爬长城的爷爷
npcs.role: an old man climbing the Wall one step at a time
knows: He climbs a little further every year

explains.愚公移山: 很难的事，每天做一点，就能做好。

nodes.say: 八达岭长城？二十块。请给我你的护照。
nodes.translate: Badaling Great Wall? Twenty yuan. Your passport, please.

nodes.say: 好了，这是你的票。十点的车。
nodes.translate: There you are — your ticket. The ten o'clock train.
nodes.why: Train tickets in China are sold in your own name, with your passport; the gates check it.

words.explain: 去别的国家用的小本子。

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 你没有票。去那儿买票吧。
nodes.translate: You haven't got a ticket. Buy one over there.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: The Great Wall! It goes on and on!
nodes.why: 长城 at 八达岭: the most famous stretch of the Wall, built of stone and brick along the mountain ridges.

nodes.say: 我每天走一点，这是愚公移山！
nodes.translate: I climb a little every day — 愚公移山, the Foolish Old Man moving mountains!
nodes.why: A 成语 📌 with a story: the Foolish Old Man carried two mountains away stone by stone — whatever is left, his sons and grandsons would finish.

nodes.speaker: long
nodes.why: The spirits go back to the lantern in 王阿姨's courtyard — mended now, it will be lit at night.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: Are you setting off? 一路平安 — a safe journey!
nodes.why: A 成语 📌: 一路平安 — safe all the way. 兔儿爷 stays with you: Beijing is yours to walk, and one day, maybe, another city.

nodes.say: 你能给我照一张照片吗？一，二……
nodes.translate: Could you take a photo of me? One, two…

steps.now: One last trip: the train to the Great Wall. Walk east from the 西直门 bus stop to 北京北站 and buy a ticket at the window (bring your passport).
Take the train — 京张高铁 — from the board in the concourse to 八达岭长城.
Climb the Wall east to the watchtower. The spirits are waiting.
The old man on the Wall wants a photo — count him in.

idioms.meaning: perseverance: any task can be done, a little every day

story.zh: 愚公的家前面有两座大山。愚公九十岁了，他每天和孩子们一起搬山上的石头。别人笑他。他说：“我做不完，我的孩子做，孩子的孩子做，山会没有的。”天帝听了，很感动，就把山搬走了。
story.en: Two great mountains blocked the Foolish Old Man's door. At ninety he began carrying their stones away with his sons. People laughed; he said, 'What I can't finish, my sons will, and their sons after them — the mountains won't grow.' Moved, the Emperor of Heaven had the mountains carried off.

idioms.meaning: have a safe journey; bon voyage

story.zh: 朋友要去远的地方，我们说：“一路平安！”
story.en: When a friend sets off on a long journey, we say: 一路平安 — safe all the way!

stamps.name: 照相
stamps.en: A photo on the Great Wall
